title: ruellia microphylla

This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, colds, and skin conditions, and it is also used to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
